title: Modifiers
html:
Generated loot names are stacked from client ModPAL labels. The last word on green and higher gear is a postfix. Magic and Unique words are usually a prefix. Rare can add another postfix. Mythic items keep a fixed base name and can roll an extra ending from Mythic Suffixes.

Primary-attribute last words (Beetle, Roadkill, Algae, and the rest) are listed on Name Descriptors.

How a name is assembled

items/mg/SwordMG.gc documents the weapon stack:

  • Magic: Magic + Item + Binder + Superior
  • Rare: Magic + Item + Binder + Rare + Superior
  • Unique: Unique + Item + Binder + Rare + Superior

In order that means:

  1. Level prefix — LevelPrefixModPAL.gc, Quality = NORMAL. Cosmetic words by material and level band (Ghost starts at Opaque, Dull, Dim). Weapons have their own Weapon01 list.
  2. Magic or Unique prefix — damage, resist, and other bonuses.
  3. Base item — Iron Dagger, Steel Full Plate, and so on.
  4. Binder — usually of the (LabelType = POSTFIX).
  5. Rare postfix on yellow and generated purple.
  6. Superior postfix — the last word used for STR / AGI / END / INT.

Green (Superior) is the base + binder + that last word. Blue adds the Magic prefix. Yellow keeps the last word and adds a Rare postfix. The same effect word can be a prefix at Magic and a postfix at Rare.

Min levels from ItemTimeline.gc: Superior 1, Magic 3, Rare 6, Unique 10, Mythic 15.

Mythic names

Named rainbows live in *MythicPAL.gc and also in items/pal GeneratedMythic templates (Azza Zin, The Horror, Threadz, Baby Dragon Wingblade). They have a fixed title. Mythic generators also roll endings from class / weapon / jewelry pools. Those endings are listed on Mythic Suffixes with the bonus attached to each word.

Jewelry mythic prefixes in AmuletModPAL.gc: Up-Sized (character size), Steam Rolling (DamageM), Bloodlusting (DamageB). RingModPAL.gc only has Up-Sized in its Mythic section.

Armor materials

From BaseArmorClasses.gc (former names in comments):

  • XXXLight — Ghost
  • XXLight — Cloth
  • XLight — Rubber / Padded
  • Light — Leather
  • Medium — Chain
  • Heavy — Splint
  • XHeavy — Scale
  • XXHeavy — Plate
  • XXXHeavy — Crystal

Fighter loot uses Scale / Plate / Crystal. Ranger uses Leather / Chain / Splint. Mage uses Ghost / Cloth / Padded. Icon lists are on Fighter Armor, Ranger Armor, and Mage Armor. Ninja is a cloth mesh, not a tenth material.

Weapon families

Eight families, fourteen 1H/2H tracks in ItemTimeline.gc. Crossbow and Cannon are 2H only. Physical typing from the weapon MG files:

  • Sword, Axe — slashing
  • Mace, Cannon — crushing
  • Pick, Crossbow — piercing

Gun and Staff use ranged / elemental pools, not those three physical links.
